astra_findings_disposition_matrix.summary: Historical outcome exposure survives campaign renaming
astra_findings_disposition_matrix.action: Reclassified WF1_CALIBRATION as HISTORICALLY_INFORMED_EXPLORATORY_DISCOVERY. Gated output named H41_EXPLORATORY_DIRECTIONAL_CANDIDATE_LOCK_V1. Sealed WF1_VALIDATION single-candidate holdout preregistered.

astra_findings_disposition_matrix.summary: Global event census is neither literal outcome non-access nor proof of statistical independence
astra_findings_disposition_matrix.action: Distinguished causally authorized internal source reads from designer-visible outcome access. Materialized H41_TESTABILITY_RECEIPT_V1 pre-outcome. All 20 candidate slots preserved in ledger.

astra_findings_disposition_matrix.summary: Candidate semantics, availability times, and entry/exit marks are not exact
astra_findings_disposition_matrix.action: Formally closed event/PIT clock table. Established relative bar indexing B_j(t), feature cutoff at t, entry mark Open(B_{entry}(t)), Donchian range excluding test bar, D3 strict adjacent close-back, and D4 full Q80 inheritance.

astra_findings_disposition_matrix.summary: Bootstrap/max-T is a menu rather than a reproducible valid joint procedure
astra_findings_disposition_matrix.action: Frozen to single method: shared-clock, source-bundle, standardized single-step joint maximum inference. Mandated Stage R2 outcome-free synthetic validation for candidate block lengths (48h, 72h, 120h; 24h baseline diagnostic).

astra_findings_disposition_matrix.summary: 60 events / 30 days do not establish inferential adequacy or useful power
astra_findings_disposition_matrix.action: Designated 60 events / 30 days as provisional basic support floors only. Established separate support diagnostics and method adequacy states. Predeclared synthetic planning grid with 20bp decision-relevant net effect.

astra_findings_disposition_matrix.summary: Realistic net economic edge exceeds the scope of the friction-only event proxy
astra_findings_disposition_matrix.action: Narrowed claim to equal-entry-notional, event-conditioned directional expectancy after a fixed friction proxy, before funding and portfolio constraints. Maintained 24bp as diagnostic stress only.

astra_findings_disposition_matrix.summary: Source-closure checklist needs executable acceptance invariants and sequencing
astra_findings_disposition_matrix.action: Bound canonical economic OHLC rows across 16 source invariants. Source authority closure formally sequenced as a dedicated source-only task preceding implementation.

astra_findings_disposition_matrix.summary: D4 profitability cannot establish incremental cross-asset information
astra_findings_disposition_matrix.action: Restricted D4 claim to conditional subgroup expectancy only. Prohibited incremental or independent cross-asset predictive claims.

astra_findings_disposition_matrix.summary: Optional calibration and later policy search need a separate selection boundary
astra_findings_disposition_matrix.action: Completely removed probability calibration from the formal H41 V1 Candidate-Lock path.

astra_findings_disposition_matrix.summary: Section 17 says candidates are authorized despite pre-freeze status
astra_findings_disposition_matrix.action: Corrected wording from authorized to proposed. Reaffirmed H41_PROTOCOL = NOT_FROZEN and all authorization flags = NO.
